_comment: specs/036-news-semantic-search T023 — a small seeded corpus for the semantic-news integration tests. Each article carries `topic_weights`; the test builds a unit vector from them in a fixed 8-topic space (TOPIC_INDEX in test_chat_news_semantic.py) and stores it as `embedding` with `embedding_model == settings.ollama_embed_model`. `published_days_ago` is turned into `published_at` relative to a fixed `now`. This is a recorded fixture — no live nomic-embed-text call.
